changelog:
- Initial release of the Quest Master Skill.
- Automatically generates daily main and side quests tailored to player goals and stats.
- Supports weekly "boss fights" that break big goals into multi-phase challenges with bonus rewards.
- Adapts quest difficulty based on player performance and stat progress.
- Parses natural language reports to process quest completions and XP awards.
- Ensures quest variety and includes both easy wins and stretch challenges.
